value.reason: The Evidence traces the full flow, and it matches the positive example. The product-details component sets the review author to the logged-in user's account email (user?.email). That value is sent in the PUT /rest/products/:id/reviews body. createProductReviews.ts stores req.body.author in reviewsCollection without changing it. The public endpoint GET /rest/products/:id/reviews (server.ts:672) then returns the stored review records in full through res.json(utils.queryResultToJson(reviews)) at showProductReviews.ts:45. The author field is never removed, so anyone who calls the endpoint can see reviewers' account email addresses. The negative example shows the safe pattern, which returns only selected fields such as the message. That is a property-level overexposure of personal data on a public API, and it lacks a basic safeguard against personal data disclosure.
